what: Keystroke input-to-paint (Event Timing) while typing 60 ms/char into the composer, by the procedure of the diagnosis that named the cause (docs: evidence/typing-latency/procedure.md): production builds served from scratch copies under an isolated HOME/XDG_CONFIG_HOME/TMPDIR/state directory with the control URL on a closed port, copies of the diagnosis's seat transcripts, headless Chromium 1600x1000, Ukrainian interface, no extra emulation. Base and head alternate inside each repetition (order swaps every repetition) so both see the same machine phase.

percentiles: p50/p90/max are the diagnosis's own: over the reported keydown, keypress, input and keyup events of at least 16 ms for the seat runs, over the reported input events for the board runs. Event Timing reports in 8 ms steps and omits events under 16 ms, so `reported` says how many of the keys were slow at all. allKeysP50/allKeysP90 count every typed character once by its input event, an unreported key as 8 ms.
